body:
The counter Chart view is rebuilt for desktop, tablet and phone at the owner's request. The plot comes first: range presets share the heading, the counter list is a side rail on wide screens and collapses in place to one row on tablets and phones. Period totals are bars with a stub for a recorded zero; a running total is a stepped line; dense ranges fall back to lines. Counters have eight validated colours that follow the counter, not its position. Statistics and rates share one summary that becomes cards on narrow screens. Reads, API, CLI and stored rates are unchanged.

The 16-step gate passes (389 Rust, 454 Node, 9 Python tests). The charts suite passes in release Chromium and WebKit, with new layout checks at 1440/1024/768/390/320px; six neighbouring suites pass in Chromium and two in WebKit. See progress/2026-10-06-chart-redesign.md.

The rebuilt release application runs at its existing HTTPS address. Identity, command epoch, both profiles, certificate, workspace settings and all counter series are unchanged across the restart; all 65 served assets match the build. A normally paired read-only visit of Chart at three sizes showed no error or write and its session was revoked.

Not verified: a physical phone or tablet, mouse hover in a screenshot, forced-colours and print. Acceptance of the new layout is the owner's.

metadata.summary: Chart view redesigned for desktop, tablet and phone
